resources.string: Tailscale: connected as %1$s. This phone is %2$s on the tailnet.
Tailscale is off on this phone
Sign in to reach your computer from anywhere, not only on its own network.
Tailscale\'s page in your browser ends with Connect for %1$s, and this phone joins once you tap it. Closed it too soon? Open it again.
The sign-in isn\'t finished on your Tailscale server yet; this phone joins once it is. Closed it too soon? Open it again.
Hypernova restarted while you were signing in, and the sign-in you had open belongs to a node that\'s gone. Your browser most likely still has your account: it takes a tap or two.
Your tailnet approves new devices: approve %1$s in your Tailscale admin console, under Machines, and it connects by itself.
Your Tailscale server approves new devices: approve %1$s there, and it connects by itself.
Tailscale is on in this app, but your Mac doesn\'t answer on the tailnet. Check that it\'s awake and that Hypernova runs there, signed in to the same Tailscale account.
